question_id: <bank: an AssessmentQuestion.id | runtime: <primary concept id>.adhoc-<8 hex of the prompt hash>>
concept_ids: <concept id(s) this question tests, primary first>
prompt: <bank: AssessmentQuestion.prompt | runtime: exactly as the student typed it>

learning_objectives.id: <objective id (must belong to one of concept_ids)>

prerequisite_concepts.concept_id: <a direct prerequisite of one of concept_ids>
prerequisite_concepts.name: <copied verbatim from Concept.name>
prerequisite_concepts.relevance: <why this prerequisite matters for this question; written by the builder>

reference_answer: <full worked answer, machine-checked where possible; access restricted; MUST NOT be shown to the student>
rubric: <grading criteria used by the Tutoring Engine; bank: AssessmentQuestion.rubric; optional>

common_misconceptions.description: <copied verbatim from Concept.difficulty_notes[i].misconception, or written by the builder>
common_misconceptions.cue: <an observable signal the student is making this error; always written by the builder>
common_misconceptions.mitigation: <copied verbatim from the difficulty note's mitigation; optional, omit if none>

sibling_question_ids: <nearest bank question id on the same concept (empty array if none)>

provenance: <source_backed | ai_inferred (weakest link over every element above)>

built_from.course_context_schema_version: <the course_context_schema_version of the Course Context file used, e.g. 1.1>
built_from.content_sha256: <SHA-256 of the exact Course Context file bytes>
